text:
Mia: Huge shoutout to @Devon and @Lina in Ops — y'all pulled off the rollback and saved the customer demo last night. Huge relief. Also props to @Arjun for hanging on the thread. Donuts on me in the kitchen (labelled). :tada: :sparkles:

Devon: ahhh that was a wild 20 minutes 😂 team effort. rollback script did the trick, Lina ran the checks. also special mention to Kai for catching the spike in alerts. :eyes:

Lina: no drama, just scripts and tea. thanks for the calm updates, Mia — made it way easier to coordinate. :raised_hands:

Arjun: i will accept the donuts and also any leftover glory. i'll drop a pic when i grab one. :coffee: :doughnut:

Tess: can we have a tiny poll while we're at it — next on-call snack fund: react with :doughnut: for donuts, :pizza: for pizza, :sushi: for sushi? (i'm biased toward pizza)

Mia: adding a quick note — team did a great job with comms, and customer was back in 10 mins. morale intact. :heart:

ops-bot: deploy-rollback executed by Lina at 03:12 UTC. incident severity: mitigated. Logs: `rollback v1.4.9 -> v1.4.8`

Kai: tiny follow-up — i'm leaving a quick blurb in the incident doc with what triggered the spike. will ping eng-runtime for a follow-through in the morning. thanks all. :coffee:

Devon: also someone claim the last cinnamon donut pls 😅
